verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's own docs have a self-hosting section that describes running and managing the platform on your own infrastructure. The CLI docs say it helps you self host, and the product is described as open source. missing for 10: detailed self-hosting deployment docs in the pack (e.g. Docker/Kubernetes setup, requirements), feature parity with Cloud, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Self-hosting Trigger.dev means you run and manage the platform on your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your environment, deployment process, and the URLs you expose the service on.
The Trigger.dev CLI has a number of options and commands to help you develop locally, self host, and deploy your tasks.
Trigger.dev is an open source background jobs framework
